question: Which among the following received the Kerala Sangeet Natak Academy fellowship (1974)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma **received the **Kerala Sangeet Natak Academy fellowship** in **1974.**
 
• She was a **renowned classical dancer **from Kerala who specialized in the** Mohiniyattam dance form.**
 
• She was also a recipient of several **other awards **and honors for her contribution to Indian classical dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anuradha Pandey **is a **Kathak **dancer.
 
• **Shovana Narayan** is a **Kathak and Odissi** dancer. 
 
• **Mahaboob Subhani** is a **Kuchipudi** dancer.
 
• Anuradha Pandey, Shovana Narayan, and Mahaboob Subhani are **not known** to have received the Kerala Sangeet Natak Academy fellowship in 1974.
